caption: The measured head-tracking lag of 100 ms drawn against the 20 ms limit: the first 20 ms is inside the limit, the remaining 80 ms is the excess, so the lag is five times the limit and interaction fails first.

spec.aria: A timeline in milliseconds with two lanes: the allowed lag of 20 ms, and the measured lag of 100 ms shown as 20 ms inside the limit plus an 80 ms excess, five times the limit.
